# Hair strands

An original procedural scene the tests read: a sphere under 4,096 strands, each a linear USD
`BasisCurves` of eight points with a width at each, and a scalp of triangles. Generated by
`scripts/dev/fixtures/hair-strands.ts` under the repository license, with no third-party models or
groom assets. The native compiler writes the strands to `hairStrands.bin` beside the geometry pages.

`options.json` holds the world options that turn the strands on (`hairStrands`, off by default);
a host passes them as `world.hairStrands = options`.

Regenerate from the repository root with `pnpm build:native`, then `pnpm fixtures:hair-strands`;
`TRILLION3D_COMPILER_BIN` optionally selects a compatible compiler executable. Source generation is
deterministic.
